name: White Label Services
notes:
(AS44382) provides cloud infrastructure and hosting services.

Upstream connectivity (2026-10-15; link capacities confirmed by the network operator):

- AS51722 — PIXOOF TEKNOLOJI ANONIM SIRKETI: 200 Gbps; IPv4 and IPv6.
- AS19318 — Interserver, Inc: 40 Gbps; IPv4 and IPv6.

These BGP neighbours are classified as upstreams by bgp.tools and corroborated by RIPEstat.

Local connectivity to Meta, Google and X is provided via upstream peering. WLS connects to its upstream via a cross-connect at Equinix IL4, Istanbul (operator confirmed, 2026-10-15).

DDoS protection capacity: 1.2 Tbps (operator confirmed, 2026-10-15).

Observed originated prefixes (2026-10-15): 14 IPv4 and 11 IPv6. These are observed counts; contact the NOC for recommended max-prefix settings.

Routing information: https://bgp.tools/as/44382#connectivity
